source_summary: Wintry riverside scene with sparse ink and pale wash: leafless gnarled trees on snowy banks, faint horizontal mist/water bands, scattered birds, small shoreline/boat details, and foreground rocks. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_mist_water_bands
motifs.description: Isolate the faint horizontal bands of pale gray-white wash across the open middle of the painting, reading as distant mist or water surfaces. Include only the broken linear strokes and soft translucent edges, not birds, seals, calligraphy, or tree branches crossing nearby.

motifs.name: upper_scattered_geese
motifs.description: Isolate the small scattered flying birds in the upper-middle open space, including the tiny dark silhouettes arranged loosely across the misty void.

motifs.name: left_swooping_bird_pair
motifs.description: Isolate the larger swooping bird forms at mid-left, with one prominent downward-angled bird and a nearby smaller companion mark.
must_preserve: small pointed head and tail marks
pale interior wash on the body

motifs.name: right_winter_tree_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the large gnarled leafless tree cluster on the right, including the main hollow trunk, adjoining trunks, twisting branches, small bare twigs, and the birds perched among the branches. Exclude the surrounding snow banks except where they directly touch the trunk base.
must_preserve: round hollow knots and spotted bark texture
subtle warm ocher-gray wash on the wood

motifs.name: midground_leafless_saplings
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left to center midground network of smaller bare saplings and shrubs emerging from the snowy bank, including the long low branch stretching horizontally and the delicate twig lattice.
must_preserve: small dark nodes at branch joints
sparse reed-like strokes at the base

motifs.name: snowy_river_terraces
motifs.description: Isolate the layered snow-covered riverbank and water terrace shapes across the lower half, including the long pale landforms, dark under-wash shadows, and gently curving shoreline contours. Exclude tree trunks, rocks, and boat details except where the bank outline passes behind them.
must_preserve: dark gray shadow bands beneath bank edges
soft transitions between snow and water
thin ink outlines on ridge edges
layered recession from foreground to midground

motifs.name: small_boat_with_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the small dark boat-like form near the lower center-left shoreline, including the curved hull, clustered ink shapes, and tiny upright figure or bundled passenger form within it.
must_preserve: compact clustered passenger or cargo shapes
short pale highlights against the dark wash

motifs.name: foreground_rocks_on_snow
motifs.description: Isolate the scattered rounded stones and pebble clusters along the very bottom snowy foreground, including the darker shadows beneath them and the larger central-right snow-capped rock group.
must_preserve: gray wash modeling on stone faces
pale snow caps and reserved highlights
dry-brush texture along the bottom edge

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
